name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 115 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 115 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces have established a permanent presence in depopulated West Bank camps while conducting raids that captured four Islamic Jihad operatives planning attacks and killed five terror operatives in Gaza. They also raided Palestinian NGOs in the occupied West Bank and in Ramallah, targeting staff and offices. Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks, and Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker har etablert en permanent tilstedeværelse i avfolkede leirer på Vestbredden mens de gjennomførte raid som fanget fire operatører fra Islamisk Jihad som planla angrep og drepte fem terroroperatører i Gaza. De raidet også palestinske NGO-er på den okkuperte Vestbredden og i Ramallah, og målrettet ansatte og kontorer. Forsvarsminister Herzog sier at en større politistyrke er nødvendig for å dempe voldskriminalitet og bosetterangrep, og israelske etterretningssoldater avdekket et politisk skifte som rettferdiggjør sivile tap i Gaza. Konflikten forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
